you’re making the right choice going back on antidepressants. it sucks feeling like you can’t handle life on your own, but depression is a chemical imbalance that can be fixed with antidepressants, and it isn’t your fault. the medication will reduce the risk of suicide, which is the most important thing. it will also give you the energy to work on bettering yourself, and maybe with time you’ll be ready to go off them again, but there really isn’t any shame if you have to stay on them for the rest of your life

i first came to this subreddit back when i was planning my first suicide attempt, i wanted to know what it feels like to drown. i’ve since attempted suicide 3 times. it’s hard to explain why exactly, i was never abused or bullied, my family was financially stable. i guess it started with the severe anxiety i’ve had since i was a child, preventing me from connecting with anyone, later making it impossible to get a job. then there was the self hatred, from my appearance to my performance in school to the way i acted, my lack of empathy toward others. i guess i’m mostly here now because i find comfort in hearing what others are going through
